source_quality.count_note: GPU and CPU retained counts differ; both use the same pooled quality criterion. ESS/512 is an equivalent average from pooledESS, not independent single-chain ESS estimates.
source_quality.timing_note: Sampling process wall includes warmup and output; diagnostics are separate and excluded. One-seed pilot until distinct seeds202001/303001 complete.
source_quality.sampler_phase_scope: Inclusive hopsy.sample: pool startup, pickle, IPC and array assembly included.
source_quality.worker_draw_scope: Maximum over worker PIDs of accumulated MarkovChain.draw call durations. Gaps between tasks/calls, serialization and IPC are excluded; elapsed intervals include OS descheduling and Python binding/state-copy overhead. This is a compute critical-path proxy, not pure arithmetic-only time.
